name: SMT-COMP Satisfiability Modulo Theories Competition
description: SMT-COMP is the annual Satisfiability Modulo Theories competition, benchmarking solvers on a suite of logic formulas spanning theory combinations such as arithmetic, arrays, bit-vectors, strings, and uninterpreted functions. Systems are evaluated on correctness and performance across multiple divisions and tracks.
evaluation_method: Solver correctness on benchmark instances, typically combined with time/resource limits and competition scoring across solved instances, speed, and soundness.
typical_sota_score: Varies widely by division; reported solve rates typically range from ~60% to 100% depending on track and difficulty
notes: Long-running and influential formal-methods benchmark with many tracks and yearly updates; exact aggregate score varies by division and year.
